## spaceman system backup

Backups of a running central: list, create and verify (restore is offline: `spaceman backup restore`).

Aliases: `backups`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman system backup create`](#spaceman-system-backup-create) | Start a backup now |
| [`spaceman system backup list`](#spaceman-system-backup-list) | Backups and the backup configuration |
| [`spaceman system backup verify`](#spaceman-system-backup-verify) | Verify a stored backup |

## spaceman system backup create

Start a backup now.

```sh
spaceman system backup create [flags]
```

API: `create-backup` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman system backup list

Backups and the backup configuration.

```sh
spaceman system backup list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-backups` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman system backup verify

Verify a stored backup.

```sh
spaceman system backup verify <backup> [flags]
```

API: `verify-backup` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman system info

Version, readiness and bootstrap state (needs no token).

```sh
spaceman system info [flags]
```

API: `get-system-info` ([HTTP API](../api)).
